publication.pass_order: interleaved with a second code state in one session: pass A, then pass B
publication.value: per cell and measurement, the mean of the passes' values; each pass is bench_snapshot's aggregate (median over 3 rotated rounds, fresh process per cell); round_min_ms / round_max_ms span the round medians of all passes; peak memory is the mean of the passes' peaks

noise_floor_between_passes.what: |a / b - 1| of the same cell between every pair of passes

publication.gpu_suspect_rule: gpu_ms > 1.05 x the wall median (bench_snapshot), or flagged in any pass
publication.tree: the lutorch_ex source measured is byte-identical to commit f88dd711 (git diff empty); it was installed as a detached worktree at its parent with f88dd711's change applied, each with its own fresh extension build
publication.gate: full GPU suite on that fresh build before any timed cell: 1680 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
